concepts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE premium Google Play FEATURE GRAPHIC concept for the Bosnian app Vaktija. This is a wide landscape banner, intended final size exactly 1024 x 500 px (aspect ratio 2.048:1). Use a flat opaque full-bleed canvas, no transparency.
Text must be EXACTLY these two elements, with correct Bosnian accents:
App name: "VAKTIJA"
Tagline: "Vaš saputnik u svakodnevnom ibadetu."
You may wrap the tagline into two balanced lines, preserving every word and the final period. No extra words, labels, feature lists, dates, Arabic calligraphy, buttons or watermarks. Make both text elements highly readable at small banner size. Keep key copy and focal artwork within generous central safe margins, never touching outer edges.
The brand palette is warm ivory, deep emerald, muted sage and restrained gold, with elegant editorial serif typography. Match the calm, refined character of the approved store screenshots. No phone or tablet mockups, no device frames, no screenshots, no UI cards, no large duplicated app-icon tile, no store badges, no ratings, no awards, no price claims, no people or hands. Use only tasteful artistic imagery relevant to the app's mosque / landscape identity. The reference screenshot is STYLE ONLY: use its typography and palette, do not reproduce its phone or text.
Return ONE complete banner concept, not a comparison sheet, not a poster photographed in a room.
DIRECTION 1: SUNRISE PANORAMA. Reference image 1 is the app's actual light mosque-and-lake artwork: use this as the visual world, expanding it naturally into the wide canvas. Reference image 2 is only the approved ivory editorial type/palette reference. A tranquil illustrated sunrise, misty sage mountains, emerald cypresses, a graceful mosque, a still reflective lake, soft warm gold light. Place a clear elegant "VAKTIJA" wordmark around the upper-middle-left and the tagline below on two lines, "Vaš saputnik u" / "svakodnevnom ibadetu.", against quiet ivory sky. The most recognizable mosque sits toward the right-center, with atmospheric landscape extending to edges and the reflection along the bottom. Keep the architecture subordinate to the text, avoid dense detailing. Restrained warm cream sky, sage and emerald lower third, sophisticated premium illustration. Spacious, bright, inviting; closely related to the approved day-theme screenshots.
